Title: Public Preview: Microsoft DocumentDB Docker Image

Body.Content:
Introducing the Microsoft DocumentDB Docker Image, a local development environment you can use to build and test apps with DocumentDB. This image simulates the DocumentDB on your local machine, providing a fast, cost-effective, and isolated environment for development. You can also integrate the DocumentDB Docker Image into continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to support automated testing and validation of app behavior against a local instance, ensuring smooth deployments and consistent performance across environments. 

Learn more.
